.github/workflows/ci.yml.content:
name: RFS skill quality and repository privacy
on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
  pull_request:
  workflow_dispatch:
permissions:
  contents: read
jobs:
  audit:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 12
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        python-version: ['3.10', '3.12', '3.13']
    env:
      PAPERBANANA_ROOT: ${{ github.workspace }}/research-figure/kernels/design
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v5
        with:
          persist-credentials: false
      - uses: actions/setup-python@v6
        with:
          python-version: ${{ matrix.python-version }}
      - name: Install canonical exchange dependencies
        run: python -m pip install -r research-figure/requirements-exchange.txt -r research-figure/requirements-plot.txt -r research-figure/requirements-native-qa.txt
      - name: Validate open Agent Skills specification (reference implementation)
        if: matrix.python-version == '3.12'
        run: |
          python -m pip install "git+https://github.com/agentskills/agentskills.git@69ef37e9424c0a7ea9dd2293b559e43ec8176379#subdirectory=skills-ref"
          skills-ref validate research-figure
      - name: Validate Agent Skill package
        run: python research-figure/scripts/check_skill.py
      - name: Verify embedded source integrity
        run: python research-figure/scripts/upstreams.py verify
      - name: Scan tracked files for secrets and private developer state
        run: python research-figure/scripts/check_repository.py --root . --tracked
      - name: Run offline unit/regression tests
        run: python -m unittest discover -s research-figure/tests -q
      - name: CLI startup and doctor
        run: |
          python research-figure/scripts/rfs.py --help > /dev/null
          python research-figure/scripts/rfs.py doctor > /dev/null
          python -m compileall -q research-figure/scripts
      - name: Exercise real embedded kernels offline
        run: python research-figure/scripts/smoke_kernels.py
      - name: Build complete installable package
        run: python research-figure/scripts/build_package.py --out /tmp/research-figure-0.8.0.zip
      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        if: matrix.python-version == '3.12'
        with:
          name: research-figure-0.8.0
          path: /tmp/research-figure-0.8.0.zip
          retention-days: 14

research-figure/tests/test_ci_configurat.content:
"""Workflow packaging guards; YAML parsing augments the always-on shape checks."""
from pathlib import Path
import unittest

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]


class CIConfigurationTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_ci_steps_are_separate_and_ship_embedded_sources(self):
        workflow = ROOT / '.github/workflows/ci.yml'
        if not workflow.is_file():
            self.skipTest('Installable Skill intentionally omits repository GitHub workflows')
        source = workflow.read_text(encoding='utf-8')
        self.assertNotIn('scripts      - name:', source)
        self.assertIn('\n      - name: Exercise real embedded kernels offline\n', source)
        self.assertNotIn('repository: douxl-lab/PaperBanana', source)
        self.assertIn('research-figure/kernels/design', source)
        self.assertIn('scripts/upstreams.py verify', source)
        try:
            import yaml
        except ImportError:
            return  # Structural guards above do not require a new dependency.
        document = yaml.safe_load(source)
        steps = document['jobs']['audit']['steps']
        self.assertTrue(any(s.get('name') == 'Exercise real embedded kernels offline' for s in steps))
        self.assertTrue(any(s.get('name') == 'Build complete installable package' for s in steps))
        for step in steps:
            self.assertNotEqual('uses' in step, 'run' in step, step)


if __name__ == '__main__':
    unittest.main()
